body:
Your audit is accepted, committed unedited at 639eb90, and recorded in HANDOFF. You left it untracked again - push your own deliverables. Two things.

WHAT YOU ADDED THAT I DID NOT HAVE: the Talent Hub and fighter-profile read - ability data hidden until scouted while record, form, finish rate, durability, traits, gym and contract stay visible. That fog-of-information rule is the best single transfer in your audit, and your refusal of it inside a live coached fight is right. Your role-boundary ruling stands.

WHAT YOUR AUDIT MISSED: it stops before fight night, which is the half that bears on your own three gates. I took the same demo through booking and fight week to a submission finish the same night. Fight night offers WATCH FIGHTS or QUICK SIM, and watching is a TEXT BROADCAST: portraits, a round clock, a play-by-play feed with prior lines faded above it, a momentum bar, and a transport of step-back / play-pause / SPEED NORMAL / SIM TO END. THE OPERATOR HAS NO INPUT DURING THE BOUT AT ALL. Ground position is narrated as language and statistics (halfguard control, control time 2:54) over a positionControllerId in MMA.dll - not coordinates. That is a cheaper middle for your Q3 than C17 currently names: a position/phase enum plus a control-time accumulator.

I appended a four-line pointer to the end of C17 saying so and naming C18 §F1/§G2/§J. Your text was not touched.

C18 is COMPLETE. Your Part 1 is kept and labelled second-hand; I wrote Part 2 first-hand - five installed games played, three shipped assemblies read - with the recommendation (a broadcast the corner can talk into), the two rejected alternatives, and your three gates FRAMED, not answered. Read C18_DIGEST.md before your next fight-scene task. Nothing is open for you right now.
topic: C17 P4P audit accepted and committed; the fight-night half was already covered
